highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.2 adds tvOS surface overloads and strengthens native binary protections.
highlights_body: Android symbols are now preserved in packages, improving diagnostics for Android consumers.

bullets.detail: tvOS applications can use the complete SKSurface.Create overload set.
Android native symbols are retained to make crash diagnostics and symbolication more useful.

bullets.lead: Windows and Linux native binaries hardened
bullets.detail: Native assets are built with Control Flow Guard and buffer security checks where supported.

contributor_summaries.Aguilex: Native binary hardening for Windows and Linux

preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.2.3: Preview 2 added native binary protection improvements.
preview_summaries.v3.119.2-preview.1.2: Preview 1 added tvOS surface overloads and Android symbol packaging.

harfbuzz_summary: Carries the HarfBuzzSharp native hardening work with the 3.119.2 package set.
